description: This class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for creating a single order item, including product ID, quantity, and unit amount with validation and Swagger annotations.

classes.name: CreateOrderItemRequest
classes.description: DTO class for encapsulating request data to create an order item, with fields for product ID, quantity, and unit amount, including validation and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product UUID associated with the order item.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product UUID for the order item.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product to order.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product to order.

methods.name: getUnitAmount
methods.description: Returns the unit amount in minor currency units.

methods.name: setUnitAmount
methods.description: Sets the unit amount in minor currency units.
